name: Boku ga Inai Ma ni Kaerareta Tsuma no Hiniku ~Love Love Shinkonzuma wa Hoka no Otoko ni Dakare Midara ni Aegu Yume o Miru ka~
original_name: 僕がいない間に変貌えられた妻の秘肉 ～ラブラブ新婚妻は他の男に抱かれ淫らに喘ぐ夢を見るか～
source:
New Bride Heroine Cuckold AVG !

Two men approach a couple who were living a lovey-dovey newlywed life.
Is it out of malice or pure longing for love?
This work is designed to be a classic cuckold story,
where you can experience a sense of frustration and despair in either man's route.
The slightest carelessness, the slightest incident, is a signal that your wife is about to be corrupted by another man...
